emailTemplate.subject: Login from a new location
emailTemplate.body:
Hello,

We noticed a login to your {APP_NAME} account from a new location.

If this was you, you may disregard this email.

If this wasn't you, you should immediately change your {APP_NAME} account password to revoke access from all other locations.

Thanks,
{APP_NAME} team

emailTemplate.subject: OTP for {APP_NAME}
emailTemplate.body:
Hello,

Your one-time password is: {OTP}

If you didn't ask for the one-time password, you can ignore this email.

Thanks,
{APP_NAME} team

verificationTemplate.subject: Verify your {APP_NAME} email

Click on the button below to verify your email address.

Verify

Thanks,
{APP_NAME} team

name: labels_stats
viewQuery: SELECT l.id AS id, l.name AS name, l.slug AS slug, COUNT(cl.id) AS uses FROM labels l LEFT JOIN contents_labels cl ON cl.label = l.id GROUP BY l.id, l.name, l.slug

name: uploaders_stats
viewQuery: SELECT u.id AS id, u.name AS name, u.aliases AS aliases, u.user AS user, u.created AS created, COUNT(c.id) AS uploads FROM uploaders u LEFT JOIN contents c ON c.uploader = u.id AND c.filetype != 'sticker' GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.aliases, u.user, u.created
